name: Quick Share
description: Send and receive files, links and text with Android phones over Google Quick Share, with fast Wi-Fi transfers even when the phone is on another network. Phones connect over Bluetooth LE without pairing; when a connection uses Bluetooth Classic instead, the daemon answers that phone's pairing request itself and removes the pairing afterwards. Builds its background service from source with one click (needs Rust). Optional for laptops with one Wi-Fi card: a small Wi-Fi helper that runs as root, installed to /usr with a polkit rule that lets your session run it without a password.
author: jhannesreimann
